title: Halfway calculator
notes: Serverless P2 halfway / checkpoint calculator from C4 quantile lookup (c4-quantile-lookup-v1, as_of=2026-09-06). Empirical finish-time p10–p90 conditional on cum_20 (5-min bins) and pace_first_half; min_n=50. Tokyo thin_course (n_finish=353, n_cum20_bins=3) — many bins omitted as sparse; Sight should fall back to unconditional. Athens/Honolulu/Mexico City have no_cum20_splits — unconditional only. Never invents sparse cells. Never writes race_records.
method: Copy C4 city JSON (artifacts/c4/*.json) into data/; course_coverage from C4 index; example_halfway_to_finish_quantiles = non-sparse conditional_cum20 bins for majors; lookup via gap_substrate.quantiles.lookup_finish_quantiles. No live DB. No race_records writes.
caveats: min_n=50: sparse bins omitted (never invent quantiles).
Tokyo thin_course: n_finish=353; prefer unconditional / widen bins.
no_cum20_splits cities (Athens, Honolulu, Mexico City): unconditional finish quantiles only.
implementation: C4 sidecar JSON copy + coverage/example CSV aggregates; serverless Sight lookup.
